description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

TSMC is hiring a new graduate Software Engineer to develop cloud-native software supporting its global operations and semiconductor fabrication. The role involves building and maintaining software applications and tools, solving technical problems, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable systems.
New Graduate Software Engineer designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software applications and tools for global operations

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications and tools that enhance our global operations
• Analyze technical challenges and provide creative, efficient solutions for complex problems
• Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code while following industry best practices and coding standards
• Work closely with cross-functional teams, including hardware, product management, and QA, to ensure seamless project delivery
• Stay curious and continuously learn about new technologies, tools, and best practices in software engineering
• Assist in troubleshooting and debugging software to ensure reliability, performance, and scalability

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
• Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Java, C++, or Go
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a passion for tackling technical challenges
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment
• A genuine interest in software development and a desire to contribute to innovative, impactful projects
• Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the United States. We cannot provide visa sponsorship at this time
